issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Boolean that indicates whether the K8s container should be started with a read-only root filesystem.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Boolean controlling Controls whether a process can gain more privileges than its parent process.

linuxCap.description: LinuxCap that contains all default linux capabilities.

fsGroup.description: Group ID (GID) applied to mounted volumes for setting file ownership and permissions.

runAsUser.description: User ID (UID) under which all container processes will run by default.

runAsGroup.description: Group ID (GID) under which all container processes will run by default.

envVars.description: Environment variables that are to be added to the container.

seccompProfile.description: seccompProfile that contains type and localhostProfile.

containerImageRegistry.description: containerImageRegistry that represents the image registry the current container is using.

containerImageRepository.description: containerImageRepository that represents the image repository the current container is using.

containerImageTag.description: containerImageTag that represents the image tag the current container is using.

volumes.description: Volumes that are to be added to the container.

volumeMounts.description: Volume Mounts that are to be added to the container. The respective volumes must be defined in the {@link K8sContainerConfig#volumes} field.

symLinkedVolumeMountPaths.description: Volume Mount Paths that are now supported through symLink, require for managing backward compatibility.

cpu.description: The number of CPUs. Currently being used only for the c3-server-log container.

memoryMb.description: The CPU memory size in MB. Currently being used only for the c3-server-log container.

title:
Represents additional configuration options for a K8s container brought up through C3server via Cloud Framework.
This Config is identified by the name of the container that the configuration applies to.
Current support is only for the "c3-server" container and "c3-server-log" container.
name: K8sContainerConfig
